{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Evening Silk Slip Maxi Skirt, floor-length fluid drape, midnight blue (#0A192F), heavy silk charmeuse.
Cashmere Blend Turtleneck Sweater, relaxed fit through the hips with a ribbed hem, cream (#F5F5DC), fine-gauge knit.
Structured Wool Blend Blazer, single-breasted cut with notched lapels, charcoal grey (#36454F), mid-weight wool blend.
Leather Pointed-Toe Pumps, sleek silhouette with a moderate heel height of 5cm, deep burgundy (#800020), smooth calfskin leather.
Statement Gold Drop Earrings, polished finish, 18k gold vermeil metal, lightweight geometric design.

This ensemble perfectly balances the warmth of an autumn evening at the theatre with the elegance required for a formal performance setting. The midnight blue maxi skirt satisfies her specific wish for a long dress while the luxurious silk fabric catches the artificial stage lighting beautifully. The structured blazer adds a layer of sophistication suitable for smart attire, and the moderate heel provides comfort for standing or sitting during the show. Finally, the cream sweater introduces a soft contrast that keeps the look refined without being overly heavy, ensuring she feels confident and stylish from curtain rise to bow."}
